item.title: Bank Hapoalim offers emergency grants to Zarzir residents whose homes were hit by missile
item.description: Bank Hapoalim will grant 2,000 shekels and emotional support to customers whose homes were damaged in the Iranian missile strike in northern Israel village Zarzir

item.title: Hezbollah launches 217 rockets and drones at Israel in rare overnight barrage
item.description: Hezbollah launched more than 200 rockets at Israel in the past 24 hours, with 127 crossing into Israeli territory — nearly matching the roughly 300 missiles Iran has fired since the war began

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei in his first message: 'We will avenge the blood of our martyrs'
item.description: Twelve days after Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in the war’s opening strike, Iran released the first message from his successor, Mojtaba Khamenei, who vowed to continue attacks on the US, Israel and Gulf states while calling for revenge for 'the blood of the martyrs'

item.title: Iranian hackers breach IDF Spokesperson’s Unit officer’s phone, leak contact details
item.description: Iranian hacker group 'Handala' published contact names and phone numbers from the phone of an IDF Spokesperson’s Unit officer; the IDF says the breach occurred about six months ago and the data was only recently reposted, prompting new security guidelines for personnel

item.title: US refueling plane crashes in Iraq; second aircraft declares emergency, lands in Israel
item.description: US Central Command says a KC-135 refueling plane carrying six crew members crashed in western Iraq 'not from enemy fire or friendly fire'; a second aircraft involved in the incident declared an emergency and landed at Ben-Gurion Airport
